# Every file this fork changes against upstream's main. .github/scripts/check-fork-allowlist.sh
# fails on a changed file not listed here, and on a line the fork no longer changes. A line ending
# in / is a directory the fork owns, where upstream has no file. Add a file here in the same change
# that first edits it. When the daily sync pull request fails on a line the fork no longer changes,
# because upstream took the change, remove the line with a commit on the sync branch.
